name: Alcon Inc.
tagline: Global leader in eye care innovation and surgical solutions.
hero_kpi_rationale: Chiffre d'affaires du premier trimestre 2026 de 2,685 milliards USD en hausse de 10% en base rapportée et 6% en devise constante, démontrant la croissance solide tirée par les lancements de nouveaux produits et la résilience du portefeuille équilibré.

kpis.explanation: Total revenue for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026.
kpis.signal: Strong quarterly sales growth driven by new product launches.
kpis.description: Net sales for Q1 2026 were $2.685 billion, up 10% on a reported basis versus Q1 2025 ($2.451 billion), and up 6% on a constant currency basis.

kpis.explanation: Non-IFRS core operating income as a percentage of net sales.
kpis.signal: Stable core operating margin despite investment in new product launches.
kpis.description: Core operating margin of 21.2% for Q1 2026, up 0.4 percentage points versus Q1 2025 (20.8%), demonstrating resilience despite efficiency initiatives and tariff impacts.

kpis.explanation: Non-IFRS free cash flow for the three-month period.
kpis.signal: Stable free cash flow generation supporting capital allocation.
kpis.description: Free cash flow of $279 million for Q1 2026, essentially flat versus Q1 2025 ($278 million), supporting dividend payments and share repurchase programs.

kpis.explanation: Dividend approved by shareholders at the Annual General Meeting.
kpis.signal: Consistent dividend distribution demonstrating shareholder returns commitment.
kpis.description: Dividend of CHF 0.28 per share approved at AGM on April 30, 2026, payable on or around May 7, 2026, up from CHF 0.24 in prior year.

kpis.explanation: New share buyback program authorized by the Board.
kpis.signal: Capital return to shareholders over three-year period.
kpis.description: Board authorized repurchase of up to $1.5 billion of common shares on May 5, 2026, to be completed over a three-year period and cancelled as return of capital.

kpis.explanation: Net sales from surgical segment including implantables, consumables and equipment.
kpis.signal: Strong surgical segment growth driven by equipment launches.
kpis.description: Surgical segment net sales of $1.460 billion for Q1 2026, up 10% reported and 6% constant currency versus Q1 2025 ($1.331 billion).

kpis.explanation: Net sales from vision care segment including contact lenses and ocular health.
kpis.signal: Strong vision care growth driven by dry eye product portfolio.
kpis.description: Vision Care segment net sales of $1.225 billion for Q1 2026, up 9% reported and 6% constant currency versus Q1 2025 ($1.120 billion).

ai_positioning.summary: Aucune mention de l'intelligence artificielle ou de technologies connexes dans les documents fournis. La société ne semble pas positionner l'IA comme un levier stratégique actuel.
evidence: Aucune référence à l'IA, au machine learning ou à des produits intelligents dans le document.
Pas de mention de cloud, d'API, ou de fonctionnalités numériques avancées.
Focus apparent sur l'innovation en soins oculaires, les lancements de produits et la performance commerciale.
